title: Battle Initiant
description: Battle Initiant enhances battles in almost every way.
body:
# Battle Initiant **This mod is designed to make battles feel more cinematic.** ## Features **Battle Initiant includes many features. Some examples include:** * Slime Boots: Jump higher at the cost of speed * Arrow Launcher: A weapon that can shoot arrows much faster and more accurately than bows, but only has 1 enchantment, lower durability, only shoots normal arrows, and is much more expensive. * Echo Sword: A rare sword crafted with Echo Shards that can steal XP & highlight enemies * Echo Pearl: A rare item that can be thrown to recreate a Warden's Sonic Boom attack * Plasma Sword: Similar to a lightsaber, this sword lights enemies on fire and has no knockback * Ghost Charm: A rare item which allows users to fly/noclip around invisibly for 3 seconds * Knights: Upgrade villagers to knights to let them fight your enemies (including players) 

You can also make neutral knights join your side by giving them emeralds

* Archers: Give one of your knights a bow to make them an archer   * Scute Armour: Protects you from all attacks when you have all the pieces of the armour, but can only take a few hits before it breaks * Bear Trap: Trap your enemies before they can even attack you **Some other features to note:** * More Enchantments: Give your weapons some charm! * More Structures: More reason for exploration! * More Advancements: You'll always have something to do! ## FAQ **The spoiler below will give instructions and tutorials on how to use the mod. If you want to find out as you play, skip this section.**

How To Use Knights: Currently, there are 2 ways to obtain knights. The first way is to craft a Knight Upgrade (8 iron nuggets + 1 iron chestplate) then right click a villager; this will transform the villager into a knight and will automatically be on your team/side. The second way is to find a neutral knight (at one of their natural structures or spawned via commands/spawn-eggs) and to give them an emerald; this will make them join your side. Once you have knights on your side, they will attack anything you attack and attack anything that attacks you; for convienence, you can put them on leads.

What Does The "Memory Loss" Potion Do: The Memory Loss Potion reverts certain transformations of entities (for example: a knight, witch, or pillager will transform into a villager) and for other entities not on the list: it will give heavy nausea & slowness, untame them (if tamed), and make them forget who they are following/attacking.

How Does The Brutality Enchantment Work: The Brutality Enchantment for axes is slightly complicated. It basically adds a second tick of damage and a 2nd cooldown (shown on the item whilst in your hotbar), both ranging based off the level of the enchantment (there are 2 levels). However, if you attack while the 2nd cooldown isn't finished, damage will be dealt to you too.

Why Are Ghost Charms So Expensive: Balancing.
